AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price trades above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, pressing within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot at 101.39 on 2x volume with a positive MACD. However, the pattern lacks preceding Stage 2 trend structure, showing negligible relative strength compared to market leaders.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe CANSLIM deterioration: Q1 FY27 revenue collapsed 56.3% YoY while net profit contracted 25.6%. Low ROCE of 5.58% and ROE of 2.75% reflect weak operational efficiency and weak interest coverage, despite promoter ownership rising to ~63% with zero pledge.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A breakdown below 92.26 invalidates the pivot base; Minervini discipline mandates immediate exit to prevent capital erosion in an unproven microcap.

ACE.technical: Constructive double bottom breakout at 1197.20 with neckline pressure, holding firmly above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 on 1.16x volume. A bullish engulfing real body confirms institutional demand near 52-week highs.
ACE.fundamental: Dominant mobile/tower crane manufacturer (60%+ market share) benefiting from infrastructure capex. Debt-free balance sheet with stellar ROCE (31.6%) and ROE (22.8%). Operating EBITDA margins held at 20.5%; strategic KATO JV supports export expansion.
ACE.risk: A drop below 1111.18 invalidates the double-bottom pivot; enforce strict loss-cutting if support fails.

AEGISLOG.technical: Textbook high tight flag consolidation above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, approaching the 1499.30 pivot on 2.15x volume. RSI at 55 exhibits constructive momentum without extension, confirming elite relative strength.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Prime CANSLIM institutional leader: Q1 PAT surged 211% YoY and revenue expanded 37.1% on record LPG terminalling throughput. Operating margins widened to 30.5%. Return on equity is 16.3%, supported by a net-cash position and zero promoter pledging.
AEGISLOG.risk: A reversal below 1376.44 breaches the flag channel; cut losses immediately per Minervini risk parameters.

AMDIND.technical: Double bottom emerging above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, testing the 74.46 trigger on a heavy 3.16x volume spike. RSI 67 reflects strong upside thrust, but the base lacks prolonged Stage 2 overhead clearance.
AMDIND.fundamental: Turnaround quarter with Q1 FY27 net profit surging to ₹9.33 Cr on 40.7% revenue growth. However, historic profitability is erratic with multi-quarter prior losses, depressed ROCE (0.64%), and low interest coverage. Promoter holding stands at 66.7%.
AMDIND.risk: A breakdown below 64.10 shatters the base swing low, requiring an immediate stop-out.

ANANDRATHI.technical: High-quality double bottom testing the 2257.25 neckline on 1.41x volume, stacked cleanly above rising 21, 50, and 200 moving averages. RSI 56 signals coiled momentum and persistent accumulation from institutional sponsors.
ANANDRATHI.fundamental: Exemplary CANSLIM metrics: AUM expanded 21% YoY to ₹1,06,300 Cr, driving 54% top-line growth and a 74% PAT surge. Boasts superior capital efficiency (ROCE 57.5%, ROE 45.3%), zero debt, and high recurring trail commissions.
ANANDRATHI.risk: A violation of 2168.14 invalidates the double bottom neckline; execute stop-loss without hesitation.

ARROWGREEN.technical: High-velocity SEPA breakout clearing a 20-session pivot at 884.73 to print fresh 52-week highs on an explosive 9.82x volume expansion. Price is well aligned above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: Strong turnaround driven by water-soluble green film exports, delivering 111% revenue growth and 151% PAT expansion in Q1 FY27. Balance sheet is virtually debt-free with 29.6% ROCE and 21.2% ROE; promoter stake rose to 65.65% unpledged.
ARROWGREEN.risk: A drop below 800.89 penetrates the breakout base; exit promptly under Minervini risk controls.
